segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Greek Island Holidays, can I help you?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Yes, I hope so. I have a friend who’s just come back from Corfu and she’s recommended some apartments in Arilas. She thought they might be on your list.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Arilas, Arilas, let me see. Can you give me the names?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Yes, the first’s Rose Garden Apartments. I’d like to go with another friend in the last week of October.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Well, we’ve got a lovely studio flat available at that time. I’m sure you’d enjoy the entertainment programme there too, with Greek dancing in the restaurant.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: And the cost for each of us?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: That sounds very reasonable! I’m just jotting down some notes. Now the second one she mentioned was called Blue Bay.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Blue Bay? Yes, in fact, that’s very popular and it has some special features.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Really?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: The main attraction is the large swimming pool with salt water.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Much healthier, I understand.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: That’s right. And it isn’t far from the beach, either – only 300 metres, and only around half a kilometre to some shops, so you don’t have to be too energetic.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Is it much more expensive than the first one?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Let me just check. I think at the time you want to go it’s around £260 – no £275 to be exact.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Right, I’ve got that. Now there are just two more apartments to ask you about. Um, I can’t read my own writing! Something to do with sun ... Sunshine, is it?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: I think you meant the Sunshade Apartments. They’re on a mountainside.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Any special features?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Yes, each room has its own sun terrace and there are shared barbecue facilities.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Sounds lovely!

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Yes, it is rather well-equipped. It also provides water sports – it has its own beach. There are facilities for water-skiing.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Any kite-surfing? My friend’s quite keen.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Not at the hotel but I’m sure you’ll find some in Arilas. There’s also satellite TV in the apartments.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: And how much is that one?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: £490 with two sharing.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: You mean £245 each?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: I’m afraid not! Each person has to pay that amount and there must be at least two in an apartment.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: I don’t think that would be within our budget, unfortunately. And the last one sounds a bit expensive too – the Grand!

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Actually it’s quite reasonable. It’s an older style house with Greek paintings in every room, and a balcony outside.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Sounds nice. What are the views like?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Well, there are forests all round and they hide a supermarket just down the road, so that’s very useful for all your shopping needs. There’s a disco in the area too.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: And the price?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: £319 at that time, but if you leave it till November it goes down by 40%.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Too late, I’m afraid.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Well, why don’t I send you a brochure with full details, Ms ...?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Nash. But don’t worry about that. I’m coming to Upminster soon and I’ll call and get one. I just wanted to get an idea first.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Well, that’s fine. We’ve got plenty here when you come.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: If you’ve got a minute, could I just check a couple of points about insurance? I got one policy through the post but I’d like to see if yours is better.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Fine. What would you like to know?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Well, the one I’ve got has benefits and then the maximum amount you can claim. Is that like yours?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Yes, that’s how most of them are.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Well, the first thing is cancellation. If the holiday’s cancelled on the policy I’ve got, you can claim £8,000.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: We can improve on that, Ms. Nash. For Greek Island holidays, our maximum is £10.000.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: That’s good – of course, our holiday won’t even cost £1,000 together!

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: It’s still sensible to have good cover. Now, if you go to hospital, we allow £600.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Yes, mine’s similar.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: And we also allow a relative to travel to your holiday resort.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: My policy just says their representative will help you.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: You can see there’s another difference there. And what happens if you don’t get on the plane?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Nothing, as far as I can see on this form.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Don’t you have missed departure?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: No, I’ll just jot that down.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: We pay up to £1,000 for that, depending on the reason. And we’re particularly generous about loss of personal belongings – up to £3,000, but not more than £500 for a single item.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Then I’d better not take my laptop!

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Not unless you insure it separately.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: OK – thanks very much for your time you’ve really been helpful. Can I get back to you? Your name is?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Ben Ludlow. That’s L-U-D-L-O-W. I’m the Assistant Manager here. I’ll give you my number. It’s 081260 543216.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: But didn’t I phone 081260 567294? That’s what I’ve got on the paper.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: That’s the main switchboard. I’ve given you my direct line.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Right, thank you ...
